skills.name: Find Common Denominator
skills.definition: Finding the least common denominator and converting unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with matching denominators.

skills.name: Basic Fraction Subtraction
skills.definition: Subtracting pure fractions or fractions with same denominators.

skills.name: Mixed Number Partitioning
skills.definition: Separating and independently calculating the differences between the whole-number parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers.

skills.name: Borrowing
skills.definition: Regrouping or borrowing a unit (1 = d/d) from the whole number part to resolve a negative fraction difference.

skills.name: Simplification
skills.definition: Reducing the final fractional answer to lowest terms or eliminating zero-valued fractional parts.
